name: bgm-winner
description: BGM Winner - Sistem Pengelolaan Lapak Pasar

scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && (test -f .env || cp .env.example .env) && npm install && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run setup:backend && npm run seed && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run bundle:vercel
scripts.dev: npm run setup:backend && npm run seed && npm run start:backend
